annotations.title: Price a stamp from its size

description: Calculate the price of a custom concrete stamp from its outer dimensions. Uses the same formula as checkout. Dimensions are in inches, each at least 6", with one side 46" or less and the other 94" or less. Plates are cut in whole inches, so a fractional size is quoted (and returned) rounded up. When you have the words rather than a size, call quote_inscription instead: the size comes from the lettering. Excludes shipping and tax.

height_inches.description: Stamp height in inches. The stamp must have one side 46" or less and the other 94" or less.

width_inches.description: Stamp width in inches. The stamp must have one side 46" or less and the other 94" or less.
